products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans, including commercial real estate (owner-occupied and non-owner occupied), commercial construction, and commercial business loans, primarily to small and medium-sized businesses. These loans are underwritten individually and may be secured by real estate or other collateral, with terms typically up to five years and both fixed and adjustable rates. Delivered through in-person relationship banking and supported by digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including residential real estate loans (first and second mortgages), home equity loans and lines of credit, consumer construction loans, and other personal loans (secured and unsecured installment loans, revolving lines of credit). These are provided to individuals, with underwriting based on income, credit history, and collateral, and delivered through both branch and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit products to individuals and businesses, including checking accounts, commercial checking, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. These are delivered through retail branches and digital channels, with FDIC insurance and competitive rates.

products.name: Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers mortgage loans for home purchase and refinancing, including fixed and adjustable rate products, through dedicated mortgage centers and loan production offices. Includes homebuyer education and community events as part of the service. Delivered via in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Digital Banking and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides digital banking solutions such as mobile banking, online banking, remote deposit capture, bill payment, and cash management services for both consumers and businesses. These services are delivered digitally and are supported by investments in IT systems and technology.

products.name: Debit and Credit Card Services
products.description: Offers debit and credit card products to clients, including transaction processing, ATM access, and purchasing cards for business expenses. Services are delivered through partnerships with payment networks and outsourced ATM providers.

products.name: Digital Lidar Sensors (OS Series)
products.description: High-performance digital lidar sensors available in multiple models (OSDome, OS0, OS1, OS2) with various configurations, manufactured using proprietary semiconductor and optical technologies, and delivered as hardware for integration into industrial, robotics, automotive, and smart infrastructure applications.

products.name: Solid-State Flash Lidar Sensors (DF Series)
products.description: Solid-state digital flash lidar sensors designed for automotive and industrial OEMs, offering short, mid, and long-range sensing with high reliability and manufacturability, delivered as hardware for integration into vehicles and other platforms.

products.name: Perception Software Platforms (Ouster Gemini and BlueCity)
products.description: Software platforms that provide perception, analytics, and actionable insights for smart infrastructure, security, logistics automation, and traffic management, delivered as integrated solutions combining lidar hardware, edge processors, and cloud analytics.

products.name: ZED Cameras and AI Compute Solutions
products.description: High-performance 2D/3D cameras and embedded AI compute hardware for real-time sensor fusion and perception, ruggedized for industrial and robotics applications, delivered as hardware and software packages.

products.name: Legacy Velodyne Scanning Lidar Sensors
products.description: Surround-view scanning lidar sensors (e.g., VLP-16, VLP-32, VLS-128) inherited from Velodyne, previously marketed for various applications, now in the final stages of their product lifecycle and no longer manufactured after 2025.

products.name: Business Formation Services
products.description: Online and concierge-assisted services for forming legal business entities (LLCs, corporations, nonprofits, DBAs), including filings and related documentation, delivered via a technology platform and supported by human experts.

products.name: Compliance Services
products.description: Digital and human-assisted services to help businesses meet ongoing state and federal compliance requirements, including annual reports, regulatory filings, and compliance monitoring, delivered through subscriptions and concierge offerings.

products.name: Registered Agent Services
products.description: Subscription-based service providing a physical address and personnel to receive legal and government documents on behalf of businesses, including digitization, secure storage, and notifications, requiring staffed locations in all 50 states.

products.name: Legal Advisory Services
products.description: Subscription-based access to a network of independent attorneys and an owned law firm for legal advice, document review, and discounted legal services, delivered digitally and via phone across all 50 states.

products.name: Intellectual Property Services
products.description: Online and attorney-assisted services for trademark, copyright, and patent applications, including filings, monitoring, and legal guidance, delivered through digital workflows and human experts.

products.name: Virtual Mail Services
products.description: Subscription service providing businesses with a virtual business address, mail receipt, digitization, check deposit, and secure storage or forwarding, requiring physical locations and trained personnel.

products.name: Legal Forms and eSignature Services
products.description: Online access to a library of customizable legal forms and eSignature tools, allowing customers to draft, edit, sign, and store documents digitally via subscription.

products.name: Bookkeeping Services
products.description: Subscription-based digital bookkeeping services for small businesses, delivered online and supported by human specialists.

products.name: Business License Services
products.description: Online and concierge-assisted services to help businesses identify, apply for, and manage required business licenses, delivered via digital workflows and human support.

products.name: Estate Planning Services
products.description: Online and attorney-assisted services for creating estate planning documents such as wills, trusts, and powers of attorney, delivered through digital forms and legal consultations.

products.name: Training and Readiness Solutions
products.description: Provides full life-cycle, innovative training solutions including live, virtual, and synthetic environments, training aids, devices, simulators, and simulations, delivered both in-person and via remote learning platforms to government and commercial clients worldwide.

products.name: Integrated Supply Chain Management
products.description: Offers rapid response and deployment, smart warehouse management, distribution, and integrated and automated logistics services to ensure efficient and seamless operations for defense and national security customers.

products.name: Assured Communications and Network Systems
products.description: Delivers full lifecycle network management, installation, activation, and information assurance, including deployment, integration, and maintenance of sensors and complex systems, as well as system upgrades, obsolescence management, and multi-sensor systems for border security and critical infrastructure protection.

products.name: Mission Support and Infrastructure Operations
products.description: Provides logistics, infrastructure sustainment, contingency operations, and critical infrastructure support, including preventative and predictive maintenance, life support, emergency services, airfield management, civil engineering, and integrated electronic surveillance for defense and intelligence operations globally.

products.name: Platform Renewal and Modernization
products.description: Offers engineering, manufacturing, rapid prototyping, and maintenance services for aviation and ground platforms, including aircraft maintenance and management, repair stations, and sustainment of systems such as missile launchers and tactical aircraft radar systems, supported by in-house testing and certified quality management systems.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending

Loans are underwritten to secondary market guidelines and may be held in portfolio or sold into the secondary market.

products.name: Residential Construction Loans

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial properties such as multi-family, hotel, retail, office, and investment residential properties, including commercial construction and land development, with underwriting focused on property cash flow, borrower experience, and collateral value. Delivered through in-person commercial banking relationships.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provision of commercial loans, including lines of credit and term loans, to businesses for working capital and general corporate needs, secured by business assets such as equipment and accounts receivable, including SBA 7(a) and 504 loans. Delivered through relationship banking and in-person commercial bankers.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Secured lending products allowing customers to borrow against the equity in their primary or secondary residences, offered as both fixed-rate loans and variable-rate lines of credit, underwritten with similar criteria as residential mortgages and delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans secured by assets such as residential lots, home improvements, automobiles, boats, trailers, and other personal property, as well as unsecured credit builder and home ownership programs, delivered through branches and community outreach.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including checking (NOW), savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and brokered deposits, delivered through 18 full-service branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms. Deposits are used to fund lending and investment activities.

products.name: Patient Experience Solutions
products.description: Subscription-based digital platform and services that collect, analyze, and deliver patient feedback and business intelligence to healthcare organizations, including CAHPS-compliant surveys, discharge call workflows, rounding, and enablement tools. Delivered via digital and multi-mode channels, supporting regulatory compliance and process improvement.

products.name: Consumer Experience Solutions
products.description: Digital solutions that help healthcare organizations build loyalty and reduce friction across the healthcare journey, including online reputation management, star ratings, review monitoring, listings management, Community Insights custom research, and nGage cross-journey listening. Delivered through digital platforms and automation.

products.name: Employee Experience Solutions
products.description: Digital engagement and feedback solutions for healthcare employees, including engagement, pulse, lifecycle, Culture of Safety, Magnet RN Satisfaction, and employee rounding. Delivered via digital dashboards and tools to improve workforce wellbeing and patient safety.

products.name: Market Experience Solutions
products.description: Subscription-based market research and analytics services for healthcare organizations, including Market Insights syndicated surveys, brand tracking, competitive assessments, segmentation, and advertising optimization. Delivered via digital tools and the largest U.S. healthcare consumer database.

products.name: Governance Solutions (The Governance Institute)
products.description: Subscription-based membership services for not-for-profit health system boards and executives, including conferences, publications, advisory services, online portal, and research studies to improve governance and strategic planning. Delivered through events, digital content, and advisory support.

products.name: Huey AI (Healthcare Experience Management AI Engine)
products.description: AI-powered engine embedded in the experience management platform to automate analysis and interpretation of experience data, providing actionable insights and workflow automation for healthcare organizations. Delivered as an integrated digital tool within the broader platform.

products.name: Quick-Service Burger Restaurants
products.description: Operates Burger Time branded quick-service restaurants offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, sides, and beverages, primarily through drive-thru and take-out service. Food is prepared to order using supplier-produced patties and served hot and fresh in free-standing facilities.

products.name: Casual Seafood Restaurant
products.description: Operates Keegan’s Seafood Grille, a family-friendly, casual dining restaurant serving freshly prepared seafood dishes, daily fish specials, and beverages, with both indoor and outdoor seating and takeout options. Food is prepared in-house using local ingredients.

products.name: Coffee Shop and Bakery
products.description: Operates Pie In The Sky Coffee and Bakery, offering store-baked bread, pastries, breakfast and lunch sandwiches, soups, salads, freshly roasted coffee, smoothies, and branded merchandise. All food is freshly prepared on-site and coffee is roasted in-house.

products.name: Fine Dining German Restaurant and Bar
products.description: Operates Schnitzel Haus, a German-themed fine dining restaurant and bar offering traditional German and American menu items, wine, beer, and cocktails in an upscale setting. Food is prepared in-house and served in an elegant environment.

products.name: Casual Dining Burger Restaurants (Equity Method Investment)
products.description: Holds a minority ownership in Bagger Dave’s Burger Tavern, a chain of casual dining restaurants and bars offering burgers and related menu items. BT Brands does not control operations but recognizes its share of income or loss from this investment.

products.name: Environmental Services
products.description: Comprehensive management and operation of housekeeping, cleaning, disinfecting, sanitizing, laundry, linen, and facility maintenance services for healthcare facilities. Services are delivered through on-site management and trained staff, requiring in-person labor and regulated procedures.

products.name: Dietary Services
products.description: Management and operation of dietary departments in healthcare facilities, including food purchasing, meal preparation, and professional dietitian services. Services are delivered on-site by trained staff and managers, requiring in-person labor and compliance with dietary regulations.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans including business loans for working capital, equipment, government contract receivables, and acquisition lending, primarily to small and medium-sized businesses. Loans are originated and serviced locally, with underwriting and credit decisions made by experienced staff.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Finances owner-occupied and investment commercial real estate properties, with a focus on local businesses and investors. Loans are underwritten based on the borrower's ability to repay and the value of the underlying real estate.

products.name: Real Estate Construction Lending
products.description: Offers short-duration construction loans, primarily for residential projects, to customers and local home builders. These loans are carefully underwritten and often require a permanent loan take-out commitment.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides consumer-oriented residential real estate loans for home purchase and refinancing. Loans are originated and serviced locally, with a variety of terms and structures.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including term loans, home equity lines of credit, and overdraft protection to individuals. These are typically unsecured or secured by personal assets.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit products to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and specialized insured deposit solutions. Services are delivered through branches and digital channels.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Delivers cash management solutions for business customers, including online banking, bill pay, sweep accounts, wire transfers, remote deposit capture, and courier services. Services are enabled by advanced banking technology and digital platforms.

products.name: Mortgage Services
products.description: Provides mortgage lending services for residential real estate, including origination and refinancing. Services are delivered through both traditional and electronic channels, with compliance to regulatory standards.

products.name: Community Development Lending and Investment
products.description: Through its Community Development Entity, provides loans and investments in low-income communities, supporting affordable housing, small business financing, and economic development. Activities may include participation in New Market Tax Credit programs and other community-focused initiatives.

products.name: Architectural Coatings
products.description: Manufactures and distributes decorative paints, wood stains, adhesives, sealants, finishes, and related chemicals for residential and commercial buildings, delivered through company-owned stores, home centers, retail outlets, and direct to consumers. Production involves large-scale chemical manufacturing and global distribution networks.

products.name: Aerospace Coatings and Materials
products.description: Produces coatings, sealants, transparencies, adhesives, engineered materials, and chemical management services for commercial, military, and general aviation aircraft, delivered directly to customers and through company-owned distribution networks. Requires specialized manufacturing and compliance with aerospace industry standards.

products.name: Automotive Refinish Coatings
products.description: Manufactures coatings, solvents, adhesives, sealants, digital solutions, and paint films for automotive and commercial vehicle repair and refurbishing, distributed through independent distributors and direct sales. Involves chemical production and technical support for aftermarket applications.

products.name: Protective and Marine Coatings
products.description: Provides protective coatings and finishes for metals and structures such as ships, bridges, and rail cars, serving metal fabricators and heavy-duty maintenance contractors. Products are manufactured at scale and distributed directly and through various retail channels.

products.name: Traffic Solutions
products.description: Produces paints, thermoplastics, raised pavement markers, and advanced technologies for pavement marking, serving government and commercial infrastructure customers. Products are manufactured and distributed directly to customers and agencies.

products.name: Automotive OEM Coatings
products.description: Manufactures coatings, adhesives, sealants, metal pretreatments, and paint films for automotive original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers, including technical services and on-site application. Production is integrated into customer manufacturing operations and requires advanced chemical engineering.

products.name: Industrial Coatings
products.description: Produces coatings, adhesives, sealants, and metal pretreatments for appliances, agricultural and construction equipment, electronics, building products, kitchenware, and transportation vehicles. Products are manufactured at scale and supplied directly to manufacturers and applicators.

products.name: Packaging Coatings
products.description: Manufactures coatings for metal cans, closures, and tubes used in food, beverage, personal care, and specialty packaging. Production involves specialized chemical processes to meet regulatory and performance standards for packaging applications.

products.name: Specialty Products (TESLIN, OLED, Optical Materials)
products.description: Produces TESLIN substrate for labels and identification cards, OLED materials for displays and lighting, and optical lens materials and photochromic dyes. These products are manufactured using advanced chemical and materials science processes and supplied to specialized industrial customers.

products.name: Engineering & Design Services
products.description: Planning, design, and engineering of HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems for new and existing buildings, delivered by teams of engineers and consultants. Services are provided digitally and in-person, requiring licensed professionals and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Program & Project Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of facility projects, including assessments, space and capacity analyses, funding identification, and construction management. Delivered through in-person consulting and oversight, often under fixed-price or energy performance contracts.

products.name: Installation & Fabrication Services
products.description: Fabrication and installation of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, process, and control systems in new and existing buildings, including custom component fabrication and modular construction. Delivered by skilled tradespeople on-site, requiring physical manufacturing and regulated labor.

products.name: Maintenance & Service for Building Systems
products.description: Preventative maintenance, emergency repair, and break-fix services for building mechanical systems, including inspections, repairs, energy analysis, automation, and system certification. Delivered by technicians on-site, often under multi-year service agreements.

products.name: Homebuilding (Single-Family Attached and Detached Homes)
products.description: Designs, constructs, and sells single-family attached and detached homes across a range of price points and home sizes, utilizing subcontracted construction labor and in-house sales teams in multiple U.S. markets.

products.name: Mortgage Financing Services
products.description: Provides mortgage financing options to homebuyers through Tri Pointe Connect, facilitating the sale and closing process and generating fee income; services are offered in all markets where homes are sold.

products.name: Title and Escrow Services
products.description: Offers title examinations and escrow services to homebuyers through Tri Pointe Assurance, operating as a title agency and providing services in select states to support home purchase closings.

products.name: Property and Casualty Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Provides property and casualty insurance agency services to homebuyers through Tri Pointe Advantage, facilitating the closing process in all markets where homes are sold.

products.name: Crofelemer Prescription Drugs for Human Gastrointestinal Disorders
products.description: Proprietary, plant-derived prescription drugs based on crofelemer, manufactured via extraction and purification from Croton lechleri tree latex, delivered as delayed-release tablets or oral powder for solution, for the treatment of noninfectious diarrhea in HIV/AIDS patients (Mytesi), cancer therapy-related diarrhea, and rare/orphan GI diseases such as microvillus inclusion disease (MVID) and short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure (SBS-IF).

products.name: Crofelemer Prescription Drugs for Animal Health
products.description: Plant-derived prescription drugs for companion animals, specifically crofelemer delayed-release tablets (Canalevia-CA1) for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced diarrhea in dogs, manufactured and distributed under regulatory approval or conditional approval.

products.name: NP-300 Prescription Drugs for Infectious Diarrhea
products.description: Second-generation, plant-based oral prescription drugs (NP-300), distinct from crofelemer but also derived from Croton lechleri, in tablet form, for the symptomatic relief and treatment of moderate-to-severe diarrhea from bacterial, viral, and parasitic infections, including cholera; currently in clinical development.

products.name: Gelclair Oral Mucositis Prescription Product
products.description: FDA-approved prescription gel product (Gelclair) for the management and relief of pain from oral mucositis, a common side effect of cancer treatment, delivered as a topical gel that adheres to and protects the oral mucosa; in-licensed and commercially launched in the US.

products.name: Plant-Derived Prescription Medicines for Mental Health (Magdalena Biosciences)
products.description: Novel, natural prescription medicines derived from plants for mental health indications, initially targeting adult ADHD, developed via a joint venture (Magdalena Biosciences) leveraging proprietary medicinal plant libraries and drug development technology; currently in early-stage development.

products.name: Laboratory Instruments
products.description: Precision laboratory instruments including balances, pipettes, titrators, pH meters, analyzers, spectrophotometers, and cell counters, often integrated with embedded software and automation, manufactured and delivered globally for research, quality control, and manufacturing applications.

products.name: Laboratory Software Solutions
products.description: Software platforms such as LabX that manage, analyze, and automate data and workflows from laboratory instruments, supporting regulatory compliance and integration with customer IT systems; delivered as digital solutions alongside instruments.

products.name: Automated Chemistry Solutions
products.description: Automated laboratory reactors, in situ analysis systems, and online measurement technologies for chemical and drug discovery, process development, and scale-up, integrating hardware and software for real-time monitoring and optimization.

products.name: Process Analytics Instruments
products.description: Instruments and integrated solutions for in-line measurement of liquid and gas parameters in industrial production processes, including sensors, analyzers, and diagnostics, delivered with support for compliance and system integration.

products.name: Industrial Weighing and Inspection Solutions
products.description: Industrial scales, weighing devices, terminals, and software for manufacturing, quality control, and logistics, including product inspection systems (metal detection, x-ray, checkweighing, vision inspection) and heavy vehicle scales, manufactured and integrated into customer operations.

products.name: Transportation and Logistics Measurement Solutions
products.description: Automatic dimensional measurement and data capture solutions integrating in-motion weighing, dimensioning, and identification technologies for transport, shipping, and logistics customers, delivered as integrated hardware and software systems.

products.name: Retail Weighing and Labeling Solutions
products.description: Weighing and software solutions for food retailers, including supermarkets and hypermarkets, integrating counter, self-service, backroom, and checkout functions, as well as automated packaging, labeling, and AI-driven image recognition for fresh goods.

products.name: Service and Calibration Solutions
products.description: Service contracts, on-demand services, calibration, regulatory compliance support, performance enhancements, application expertise, and training for installed instruments, delivered globally through a dedicated service network.

products.name: Net Lease Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of income-producing net lease properties, including industrial & distribution, retail, and office properties, to external tenants. Properties are acquired, managed, and leased under long-term contracts, primarily in the U.S., Canada, and Europe. Delivery requires physical ownership and management of real estate assets, tenant relationships, and compliance with real estate regulations.

products.name: Petroleum-Based Refined Products
products.description: Production and wholesale distribution of gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and other transportation and industrial fuels, manufactured at four refineries using physical refining and blending processes, and delivered via pipelines, terminals, and bulk sales channels.

products.name: Asphalt and Industrial Residuals
products.description: Manufacture and sale of paving asphalt, roofing flux, petroleum coke, sulfur, and other residual products, produced as by-products of the refining process and sold to industrial customers.

products.name: Biodiesel Fuels
products.description: Production of biodiesel fuels at dedicated facilities using renewable feedstocks, with products distributed to wholesale customers; facilities are currently idled but may be restarted or sold depending on market conditions.

products.name: Crude Oil and Refined Product Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of fee-based gathering, transportation, storage, and terminalling services for crude oil, intermediate, and refined products, using a network of pipelines, storage tanks, terminals, and trucking assets, offered to both internal and third-party customers.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Services
products.description: Operation of natural gas gathering pipelines and processing plants, providing cryogenic processing and related services to third-party producers, primarily in the Delaware Basin, using regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Water Disposal and Recycling Services
products.description: Provision of water disposal and recycling services for oil and gas producers, utilizing dedicated water gathering pipelines and disposal facilities in the Midland, Delaware, and Bakken Basins.

products.name: Pumps and Pump Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a wide range of pumps and fully-integrated pump systems for water, wastewater, construction, dewatering, industrial, petroleum, original equipment, agriculture, fire suppression, HVAC, military, and other liquid-handling applications. Products are physically manufactured and tested prior to shipment, with models ranging from small fractional horsepower units to large, high-capacity systems.

products.name: Replacement Parts for Pumps and Pump Systems
products.description: Provides replacement parts for previously installed pumps and pump systems, supporting ongoing maintenance and operation of critical liquid-handling equipment. These parts are physically manufactured and supplied as needed for installed base products.

products.name: Debt Financing for Lower Middle Market Companies
products.description: Provision of secured first lien debt (senior loans, term loans, lines of credit, senior notes) and secured second lien debt (subordinated loans, mezzanine loans) to established private businesses in the U.S., typically requiring financial capital and structured through negotiated agreements. These debt instruments are generally interest-only, collateralized by company assets, and may include success fees or paid-in-kind interest.

products.name: Equity Investments in Private Companies
products.description: Acquisition of preferred and common equity, limited liability company interests, or warrants/options to purchase such securities, typically in connection with debt investments, recapitalizations, or restructurings. These investments are negotiated and may result in significant ownership or voting control, aiming for long-term capital appreciation.

products.name: Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive insurance packages for businesses, including fire and allied lines, liability, automobile, and workers' compensation, delivered through independent agencies and requiring regulated underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Surety Bonds
products.description: Contract and commercial surety bonds provided to businesses, particularly in construction and related industries, distributed through specialized surety agencies and requiring financial and risk assessment expertise.

products.name: Specialty and Surplus Lines Insurance
products.description: Niche insurance products such as marine specialty, professional liability, and earthquake coverage, offered through managing general agents and wholesale brokers on both admitted and non-admitted bases, involving specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Reinsurance
products.description: Property and casualty reinsurance coverage provided to other insurers through traditional treaty channels and participation in Lloyd's syndicates, involving risk assumption and capital management.

products.name: Thermal Processing Equipment
products.description: High-performance equipment including conveyorized reflow ovens, high-temperature belt furnaces, and horizontal diffusion furnaces used for advanced semiconductor packaging, electronic assembly, and wafer processing. These are physically manufactured systems requiring precise engineering and assembly, delivered to semiconductor and electronics manufacturers.

products.name: Wafer Polishing and Lapping Consumables
products.description: Consumables such as polishing templates, substrate carriers, and lapping materials used in chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and wafer processing for silicon, silicon carbide, optics, and ceramics. These are manufactured to tight tolerances and sold to semiconductor, optics, and ceramics manufacturers.

products.name: Substrate Process Chemicals
products.description: Specialized chemical solutions including slurries, detergents, coolants, and cleaning agents for grinding, lapping, polishing, cleaning, and dicing of semiconductor wafers, optics, and specialty materials. These chemicals are formulated and produced for precision surface processing applications.

products.name: Wafer Cleaning Equipment
products.description: Double-sided wafer cleaning systems (e.g., OnTrak) that use water or mild chemistries and PVA brushes to clean both sides of semiconductor substrates. These are engineered and assembled physical machines delivered to semiconductor manufacturers for post-processing cleaning.

products.name: CMP Equipment Parts and Services
products.description: Replacement parts, engineered solutions, and maintenance services for chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and wafer cleaning equipment, including reverse-engineered assemblies, custom upgrades, and support for both current and legacy platforms. These services involve in-person technical support and physical part manufacturing.

products.name: CMP Head Testing Systems
products.description: Table-top systems (e.g., Entrepix Entegrity Head Tester) for testing and analyzing CMP head consumables, providing data on performance, leaks, and cross talk. These are digital-physical hybrid products delivered to semiconductor manufacturers for process optimization.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides specialized loans and financing solutions to corporate, middle market, and small business customers, including lines of credit, term loans, equipment loans, commercial property loans, construction loans, SBA program financing, and commercial equipment leases. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Treasury Management and Payments Solutions
products.description: Offers business customers a suite of treasury management and payment services, including digital and mobile banking, ACH, wires, remote deposit capture, integrated payments and receivables, lockbox, cash vault, real-time payments, commercial cards, fraud prevention, foreign exchange, and merchant services. Delivered via digital platforms and consulting, leveraging financial technology and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides a range of deposit accounts to consumer and business customers, including non-interest and interest-bearing checking, savings, money market accounts, sweep solutions, and certificates of deposit. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Banking
products.description: Delivers financial planning, investment management, trust, insurance, and private banking services to individuals, families, and businesses through dedicated advisors and specialized subsidiaries. Services are provided via in-person and digital channels, requiring licensed professionals and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans for the construction, purchase, and refinancing of residential owner-occupied and rental properties, with various fixed and adjustable rate options. Many originated loans are sold into the secondary market, with servicing often retained. Requires financial capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individual borrowers for personal purposes, including secured and unsecured personal loans, home equity and personal lines of credit, and motor vehicle loans. Delivered through branch and digital channels, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Claseprubart (C1s Inhibitor Therapy)
products.description: A fully human monoclonal antibody therapy selectively targeting the active C1s complement protein, designed for self-administered subcutaneous injection via pre-filled pen. Manufactured using biologic processes and delivered as an injectable pharmaceutical for the treatment of complement-dependent autoimmune diseases such as generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG), Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP), and Multifocal Motor Neuropathy (MMN).

products.name: DNTH212 (Bifunctional BDCA2 and BAFF/APRIL Inhibitor Therapy)
products.description: An investigational, extended half-life bifunctional fusion protein targeting BDCA2 and BAFF/APRIL to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses in autoimmune diseases. Delivered as a self-administered subcutaneous injection suitable for a pre-filled pen, produced via biologic manufacturing processes, and intended for multiple autoimmune indications.

products.name: AVIM Therapy (Atrioventricular Interval Modulation Therapy)
products.description: A bioelectronic therapy delivered via proprietary algorithms integrated into standard dual-chamber cardiac pacemakers, designed to immediately, substantially, and sustainably lower blood pressure in patients with uncontrolled hypertension. Delivered as a firmware upgrade to pacemakers, it requires no additional hardware and is manufactured in partnership with Medtronic, which handles global commercialization, manufacturing, and distribution upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Virtue Sirolimus AngioInfusion Balloon (Virtue SAB)
products.description: A proprietary drug-device combination product for the treatment of artery disease, designed to deliver a large liquid dose of extended-release sirolimus (SirolimusEFR) to the vessel wall during balloon angioplasty without balloon coating or permanent implant. Manufactured using a microporous AngioInfusion balloon and proprietary sirolimus formulation, it is intended for use in coronary and peripheral artery disease and is undergoing pivotal clinical trials for regulatory approval.

products.name: SirolimusEFR (Extended Focal Release Sirolimus)
products.description: A proprietary, investigational extended-release formulation of sirolimus designed for localized, targeted drug delivery to treat local inflammation in tissues beyond coronary and peripheral arteries. Delivered via balloon-based or other focal delivery systems, it is in early exploratory development for indications such as urology and osteoarthritis, leveraging the same manufacturing and formulation technology as Virtue SAB.

products.name: CNT-HF (Cardiac Neuromodulation Therapy for Heart Failure)
products.description: A bioelectronic therapy candidate based on proprietary CNT technology, designed to reduce chronic sympathetic nervous system activity in heart failure patients. Delivered via implantable cardiac rhythm management devices (e.g., pacemakers or CRT devices), it is in early-stage development and leverages similar manufacturing and delivery infrastructure as AVIM Therapy.

products.name: FreeHold Devices (Hands-Free Intracorporeal Retractors)
products.description: Single-use, fully and continuously adjustable intracorporeal retractors (FreeHold Duo and Trio) designed for internal organ or tissue retraction during minimally invasive laparoscopic and robotic surgeries. Manufactured as Class I medical devices, these are sold primarily for bariatric, foregut, and other minimally invasive procedures, and distributed on a pilot basis in the U.S.

products.name: Pure-Vu System (Motus Devices)
products.description: A medical device system designed to facilitate cleansing of the gastrointestinal tract during colonoscopy and upper GI endoscopy procedures. Integrates with standard endoscopes and uses irrigation and evacuation to improve visualization, manufactured and distributed for pilot commercial use in hospitals, primarily in the U.S.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage Loans
products.description: Origination and acquisition of first mortgage loans secured by commercial properties, primarily transitional floating rate loans for middle-market multifamily assets. These loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced, requiring significant financial capital and real estate expertise.

products.name: Other Commercial Real Estate-Related Debt Instruments
products.description: Origination and acquisition of mezzanine loans, preferred equity, construction loans, and other subordinate or specialized CRE debt instruments. These are structured financial products requiring underwriting, legal structuring, and ongoing management.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS) and Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs)
products.description: Investment in and acquisition of securities collateralized by pools of commercial real estate debt instruments, such as CMBS and CRE CLOs. These are financial products purchased and managed as part of the investment portfolio, requiring capital markets expertise.

products.name: Real Estate Owned (REO) Properties
products.description: Ownership and management of multifamily properties acquired through loan foreclosure or transition. This involves direct real estate ownership, property management, and potential disposition activities.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
products.description: Servicing of residential mortgage loans previously originated and securitized, involving the collection of payments and management of loan administration. This is a legacy business line with limited ongoing activity.

products.name: Lifestyle Apparel and Accessories
products.description: A broad range of women's and men's fashion apparel, activewear, intimates, shoes, accessories, and related products sold under the Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement, Urban Outfitters, Maeve, BDG, and 'iets frans' brands. Products are designed internally, in collaboration with third-party brands, or sourced from external vendors, and are delivered through physical retail stores, digital channels, and wholesale distribution.

products.name: Home, Garden, and Outdoor Living Products
products.description: Furniture, home decor, lifestyle home, garden and outdoor living products, antiques, live plants, flowers, and related accessories primarily under the Anthropologie and Terrain brands. These products are sourced and curated for sale in physical stores and online platforms.

products.name: Beauty and Wellness Products
products.description: Beauty and wellness products, including cosmetics, skincare, and wellness essentials, offered under multiple brands and delivered through retail stores and digital channels.

products.name: Bridal and Event Apparel and Decor
products.description: Bridal collection consisting of wedding, bridesmaid and party dresses, accessories, and decor, primarily under the Anthropologie brand, sold through stores and digital channels.

products.name: Apparel Subscription Rental Service
products.description: Monthly women’s apparel subscription rental service under the Nuuly brand, allowing customers to rent and optionally purchase a wide selection of apparel from company and third-party brands via a custom-built digital platform.

products.name: Wholesale Apparel Distribution
products.description: Design, development, and wholesale distribution of women's contemporary apparel, activewear, intimates, shoes, and select apparel collections to department and specialty stores worldwide, including shop-within-shop models, under the Free People, FP Movement, Urban Outfitters, BDG, and 'iets frans' brands.

products.name: Dining and Event Services
products.description: Dining and event experiences provided through Menus & Venues locations, offering food, beverage, and event services in physical venues.

products.name: Derivatives Trading (Futures and Options)
products.description: Trading of futures and options contracts across asset classes including interest rates, equity indices, foreign exchange, agricultural commodities, energy, metals, and cryptocurrencies. Delivered via electronic platforms (CME Globex, CME Direct), open outcry, and privately negotiated transactions.

products.name: Derivatives Clearing Services
products.description: Central counterparty clearing and settlement services for exchange-traded futures, options, swaps, and OTC derivatives, ensuring risk management and capital efficiency for market participants. Delivered via integrated clearing systems such as CME ClearPort.

products.name: Securities Clearing Services
products.description: Clearing and settlement services for cash U.S. Treasury and repo transactions, provided through CME Securities Clearing Inc. (CMESC) to help clients comply with SEC clearing requirements. Service to be launched in 2026.

products.name: Cash Markets Trading Platforms
products.description: Electronic trading platforms (BrokerTec and EBS) for cash and repo fixed income products, spot and OTC FX, and spot precious metals. Delivered via fully electronic, anonymous and disclosed trading venues integrated with order entry, clearing, and settlement systems.

products.name: Market Data and Analytics Services
products.description: Provision of proprietary real-time, historical, and derived market data, as well as analytic tools and benchmark indices. Delivered via data platforms, third-party distribution partners, and cloud services (including Google Cloud).

products.name: Benchmark and Index Licensing
products.description: Licensing and distribution of proprietary and third-party financial benchmarks and indices (e.g., S&P, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, FTSE Russell, CME Term SOFR) for use in financial products and as reference rates. Delivered via licensing agreements and data feeds.

products.name: Event and Prediction Markets
products.description: Trading of simplified event contracts and prediction markets for financial, economic, and sporting events, targeting retail customers. Delivered via digital applications, including a joint venture with FanDuel.

products.name: NELL-1/DBM Fusion Device (NB1)
products.description: A bone graft medical device combining recombinant human NELL-1 protein with demineralized bone matrix (DBM), delivered as a convenience kit including a vial of NELL-1/DBM, diluent, and DBM Putty, for use in spinal fusion and potentially other orthopedic procedures. The product is physically manufactured, requires regulated infrastructure, and is delivered to surgeons for implantation during surgery.

products.name: NELL-1 Recombinant Protein Platform for Orthopedic Applications
products.description: A proprietary recombinant human protein (NELL-1) platform technology for bone regeneration, intended for use in a variety of orthopedic applications including non-union trauma cases and osteoporosis. The platform is produced via biological manufacturing and is intended for local or systemic administration, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Medical Device Components and Packaging
products.description: Manufacture and supply of specialized components, high-performance parts, and packaging solutions for medical devices and biopharma, including design, prototyping, and production services. Products are produced using advanced manufacturing and are tailored for regulated, high-quality applications.

products.name: Water Filtration and Purification Technologies
products.description: Production and sale of advanced water filtration, separation, and purification products such as ion exchange resins, reverse osmosis and nanofiltration elements, and ultrafiltration modules, serving industrial, municipal, and specialty markets. These are manufactured using proprietary chemical and membrane technologies.

products.name: Protective Garments and Suits
products.description: Manufacture and sale of protective garments and suits, including branded products like TYVEK® and TYCHEM®, designed for use in medical, industrial, and hazardous environments. These are produced using specialized materials and processes to meet stringent safety and regulatory standards.

products.name: Building Envelope and Interior Solutions
products.description: Production and supply of integrated building technologies for residential and non-residential construction, including house wrap, insulation, and solid surface materials. Products such as TYVEK® house wrap, STYROFOAM™ insulation, and CORIAN® surfaces are manufactured for energy efficiency, durability, and hygiene.

products.name: Engineered Industrial Components and Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of precision-engineered components, systems, and process solutions for industrial applications, including automotive, aerospace, and packaging. Products include specialty lubricants, structural adhesives, engineered shapes, and printing plates, produced using advanced manufacturing and chemical processes.

products.name: Geothermal Power Generation
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of geothermal power plants that generate electricity from the earth's natural heat. These plants are physically constructed, require drilling and specialized equipment, and deliver electricity to utilities and other customers under long-term contracts.

products.name: Recovered Energy Generation (REG)
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of power plants that generate electricity from recovered (waste) heat produced by industrial processes or gas compressor stations. These facilities require physical construction and integration with industrial sites, and deliver electricity to the grid or customers.

products.name: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Power Generation
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of utility-scale solar PV power plants, including standalone solar PV, solar PV plus energy storage, and hybrid geothermal-solar PV projects. These are physically constructed facilities that generate and sell electricity under long-term contracts.

products.name: Battery Energy Storage Services (BESS)
products.description: Ownership and operation of grid-connected, utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) that provide capacity, energy, and ancillary services to the electric grid. These are physical infrastructure projects generating revenue from merchant markets, tolling agreements, and capacity contracts.

products.name: Geothermal Power Plant Equipment (OECs)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of power units (Organic Rankine Cycle equipment) for geothermal electricity generation to third-party contractors, developers, and operators. These are manufactured products delivered to external customers for use in their own power plants.

products.name: Recovered Energy Power Plant Equipment
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of power units for electricity generation from recovered (waste) heat to industrial customers such as pipeline operators and cement plants. These are manufactured products delivered to third parties for use in their own facilities.

products.name: Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) Services for Power Plants
products.description: Provision of turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for geothermal and recovered energy-based power plants, using in-house manufactured equipment. These are project-based services delivered to external customers, including plant owners and industrial operators.

products.name: Geothermal Production Pumps
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of geothermal production pumps and related systems to third-party power plant operators. These are manufactured products and services delivered to external customers for geothermal applications, including district heating.

products.name: Biopharmaceutical Royalty Investments
products.description: Acquisition and structuring of royalty interests in mid- to late-stage development and commercial biopharmaceutical products, generating long-duration, non-dilutive cash flows. This is achieved through royalty purchases, development-stage financing, and acquisitions of companies or assets with embedded royalty rights. Delivery is financial and contractual, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: Captisol Technology Platform
products.description: A proprietary, patent-protected cyclodextrin excipient used to improve solubility and stability of drugs, sold as both solid powder and aqueous concentrate to pharmaceutical partners for use in drug formulations. Requires specialized chemical manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: NITRICIL Technology Platform
products.description: A proprietary nitric oxide-based drug delivery platform enabling tunable dosing and proprietary formulations for various therapeutic indications. Commercialized through partner-driven development, with recurring royalties and material sales. Infrastructure-light and IP-based.

products.name: Pelican Expression Technology Platform
products.description: A scalable recombinant protein expression system licensed to global biopharmaceutical manufacturers for the production of complex biologics, including vaccine carrier proteins. Revenue is derived from royalties and licensing income, not direct manufacturing.

products.name: HepDirect and LTP Technology Platforms
products.description: Proprietary liver-targeting prodrug technologies enabling targeted delivery of drugs to the liver, licensed to partners for application in marketed or new drug products. Revenue is generated through royalties and licensing fees.

products.name: Contract Revenue from License Fees and Milestone Payments
products.description: Revenue from upfront license fees and milestone payments associated with out-licensing proprietary technologies and product candidates to biopharmaceutical partners. This is a contractual, financial service rather than a physical product.
